product.description: Description: A pack of 50 barbed hold down pegs is a garden accessory designed to help secure 1/2" pipes used in garden irrigation systems, such as water supply pipes, seep hoses, drip lines, or any other 1/2" irrigation components. These pegs are typically made of durable materials like plastic or metal and are specifically engineered for outdoor use. They have barbs or ridges along their length to provide extra grip and stability when inserted into the soil. The pegs are usually around 6 to 8 inches long, providing adequate anchoring for the pipes. Uses: Securing Irrigation Components: The primary use of these barbed hold down pegs is to secure 1/2" irrigation pipes, including water supply pipes, seep hoses, and drip lines, in a garden or landscape. They help prevent the pipes from moving, shifting, or being exposed, ensuring that the irrigation system functions efficiently. Keeping the Garden Neat and Tidy: These pegs are essential for maintaining a clean and organized garden. By keeping the irrigation pipes secured to the ground, they prevent tripping hazards and unsightly tangles of hoses, contributing to a neater and more aesthetically pleasing garden. Preventing Damage: In windy conditions or high-traffic areas, unsecured irrigation pipes may become dislodged or damaged. Barbed hold down pegs provide a reliable way to keep the pipes in place and prevent them from being accidentally stepped on or damaged by garden equipment. Facilitating Proper Water Distribution: By holding down irrigation components close to the ground, these pegs ensure that water is distributed evenly and accurately to the targeted areas, helping maintain the health of your plants and conserving water. Easy Installation: The barbs on these pegs make it easy to insert them into the soil without the need for special tools. This makes them a convenient choice for gardeners of all skill levels. product.name: 63mm to 76mm (2 1/2" To 3") Plastic Hose Connector Red Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: 13mm 5 Metre Clear Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Wire Reinforced Hose/Pipe, Drainage Hose for Pools Hot Tub
product.description: This high-quality PVC Wire Reinforced Hose is a versatile, durable solution for fluid transfer in industrial, agricultural, and domestic applications. Constructed with a clear, flexible PVC inner and outer layer, reinforced with a galvanized steel wire helix, it offers excellent strength while maintaining transparency for easy flow monitoring. Suitable for water, light chemicals, and non-food liquids, this hose withstands working pressures of up to 12 Bar depending on size, and temperatures from -10°C to +65°C (peak +70°C). Its robust design resists kinks and crushing, making it ideal for suction and delivery tasks. Fully compliant with BS EN 10324-2005 standards, the hose is available in a wide range of diameters and supplied in custom lengths from 1 metre to 100 metres. Whether in workshops, construction sites, farms, or gardens, it delivers dependable performance and long service life. Lightweight yet strong, the PVC Wire Reinforced Hose is the practical choice for demanding environments where flexibility and reliability are essential.

product.name: 5mm 2 Metre Clear Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Reinforced Hose/Pipe, Drainage Hose for Pools and Hot Tubs
product.description: This PVC Unreinforced Hose is a versatile and cost-effective solution for low-pressure fluid transfer. Manufactured from high-quality soft polyvinyl chloride (PVC), it offers excellent flexibility and clarity, making it ideal for visual flow monitoring in air, water, and light chemical applications. Available in sizes ranging from 3mm to 25mm internal diameter, it is suitable for use across various domestic, industrial, and laboratory settings. Each hose provides consistent wall thickness and smooth bore for reliable flow, supported by a durable design with no reinforcement, keeping weight to a minimum. The hose performs optimally within a temperature range of -10°C to +65°C, with a peak tolerance of up to +70°C. The hose accommodates bending radii from 20mm to 180mm depending on the size selected, and supports working pressures up to 1.5 Bar and burst pressures up to 4.5 Bar. Whether you're irrigating your garden, setting up water cooling systems, or routing air lines in workshop settings, this transparent hose offers a clean, easy-to-use, and durable solution.

product.name: Aveli Raised 1000 x 760mm Non-Slip Shower Tray with Black Waste
product.description:
This Podium raised rectangular shower tray measures 1000 x 760mm and is designed for straightforward installation in a wide variety of bathroom settings. Supplied in a white finish with a non-slip surface, it ensures improved safety and durability, making it especially suitable for family bathrooms or high-traffic environments. With a height of 140mm, the tray offers sufficient clearance and is universally compatible with most shower enclosures and screens. It complies with British and European standards, is WRAS approved, and is manufactured in the UK. The high-flow waste enables rapid water removal at up to 32 litres per minute, and the tray comes with a 25-year warranty for added reassurance.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Black - 600mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: Terma Radiator Forte (Single Panel), 1800h x 588w (mm), White RAL 9016
product.description: Forte is a flat bar range of designer radiators available in both single or double panel variants; each bar is 70mm wide with a small gap which creates a very seamless looking design set against the wall. The Forte single panel (V10) model is manufactured from a single layer of flat steel profiles mounted on round rear collectors, with a very shallow projection of just 73 mm including fixings, meaning this model is well suited to spaces where the overall projection is limited. Note: Terma also offer a Forte double panel (V20) model which has a deeper projection of 93mm. This white (RAL 9016) colour has a silk, smooth texture. Terma offers a 150x50mm colour chip of this finish should you wish to see the colour prior to purchase. The Forte range have the unique feature that they can be installed either... vertically with the bars running up and down (valves connected on the sides)... or they can be installed horizontally with the bars running left to right (valves connected on the undersides). The same physical model you buy can be installed either way up giving maximum flexibility dependant on your space requirements. See the images for how the radiators look each way up as they can give a very different looking design as you rotate each model and we show images of these fitted both ways for every size. Forte is supplied with a universal bracket which allows the radiator to be installed either way up, full instructions supplied. As you rotate the radiator either way up it changes the view you will have of the brackets from the side of the radiator. With the bars running vertically the brackets are on show, but with the bars running horizontally the brackets are fully concealed from view. See the images for this difference. Forte is pre fitted with an internal diverter (baffle) which is a barrier to aid the flow of water up and over inside the radiator to ensure even heat distribution across all bars.

Linear drain trim strips are the best solution for those who appreciate a professional approach to their bathroom finish.

Choose a practical solution:

The specifications of our decorative strips are another plus for their use in your home:
• SUS 304 stainless steel;
• thickness suitable for enamel thickness;
• dimensional accuracy thanks to laser cutting;
• durable, lightfast, and non-abrasive color achieved thanks to the PVD process;
• high thermal resistance;
• and chemical resistance.

A product with a DIY spirit:
The main advantage of our shower tray trims is their ease of installation and cutting.
Any avid DIYer can handle them without problems.
All you need for installation is tile adhesive and silicone, while cutting can be done with an angle grinder or saw blade.
This is all you need to easily achieve a beautiful visual effect.

How to choose the right strip?
Remember that strips are available in two standard lengths: 130 cm and 180 cm.

Important note :
If you use the 180 cm side profile (LPSP 180 cm) and also want to use the front profile (LC) on the front part of the shower tray,
then due to compatibility this profile must be purchased in the 180 cm version (LC 180 cm).
Likewise, the 120 cm side profile (LPSP 120 cm) must be used with the front profile (LC) of the 130 cm shower tray (LC 130 cm).
